ios.desc:
EaseQuiz makes studying more active by transforming your notes and learning materials into interactive quizzes using AI. Paste text, take a photo, or upload a PDF, choose your preferred question type and quiz length, and start testing your knowledge in seconds.

Generate multiple-choice, true-or-false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from almost any subject. Large PDFs can be narrowed to specific page ranges, while saved quizzes and questions make it easy to revisit important material later.

Stay motivated as you learn by earning XP, building daily streaks, improving your level, and unlocking badges. Your username, progress, achievements, and career statistics sync with your account, allowing you to continue across supported devices.

Features

- Generate quizzes from text, photos, and PDF documents
- Multiple-choice, true-or-false, and fill-in-the-blank questions
- Customize the number and type of questions
- Select specific PDF page ranges
- Save quizzes and individual questions for later review
- Reveal answers while reviewing saved questions
- Earn XP and advance through levels
- Build a daily learning streak
- Track accuracy, completed quizzes, best combos, and other career statistics
- Unlock and inspect achievement badges
- Sync your profile and learning progress with your account
- Export quiz results as PDF documents

Whether you are revising class notes, preparing for an exam, reviewing a document, or exploring a new topic, EaseQuiz helps turn passive reading into focused practice.
